鬆動的柵門，是引領著我們逃出生天，還是墜入深淵？
13891，新卓尼森王朝建立後 429 年，人類依然對非人生物有著很大的厭惡。
「叭—叭—叭—」巨大的聲響在牢房內響起，受刑人們本來就不安穩的睡眠更因此被打斷。
同房的龍人紅龍與魔人阿基拉起床看了看，發現牢房外的走廊上沒有任何動靜，但是柵門似乎是鬆動的。用力一扳，柵門似乎滑開了。
另一間牢房內，妖精巴巴與地精查德也被警鈴吵醒，扳開了意外鬆脫的柵門，走了出去。
獄友前一天剛被保釋的半獸人魔法香蕉先生聽見了警鈴聲，機警地躲到了牢房的陰暗角落，神經兮兮的東張西望，卻沒有動靜，因此決定用他熟悉的忍者語大喊。
混雜著普通語和其他沒有聽過語言的忍者語在牢房之間迴盪，巴巴與查德決定朝聲音的來源前進。隔幾間的牢房似乎有點動靜，兩人探了頭過去，一個臉上有著繽紛色彩的男人將臉緊緊靠了上來，十分神經質的和巴巴與查德對話。在兩人的協助下，這位名為洛根的男人便和他們一起朝著忍者語的方向前進。
與巴巴和查德不同，紅龍和阿基拉決定朝著反方向走。經過了幾間牢房，他們看見有兩人坐在地上，不發一語。紅龍試圖與他們溝通，得到的回音卻是他聽不懂的語言。在各種比手畫腳與威脅利誘下，兩名獄友終於站了起身，走近了他們。這兩名獄友似乎是妖精。扳開牢房的柵門後，四人便朝向忍者語的反方向前進。
扳開了柵門，魔法香蕉先生謹慎的靠著牆，躲在角落。此時巴巴、查德和洛根剛好從另一側的轉角走了過來。似乎對「忍者語」有一點了解的巴巴試著和在角落大叫的魔法香蕉先生溝通，對於巴巴竟然能如此順暢溝通大感震驚的魔法香蕉先生跑了出來，對著巴巴大喊忍者大師。
紅龍和阿基拉以及尾隨他們之後的兩名妖精走向另一側的轉角，看見了一扇鐵門。其中一名妖精掏出了工具，蹲了下來，在門的底下開始動手，而他的獄友則在一旁協助。紅龍和阿基拉分別站在轉角的兩側，深怕發生了什麼突發事件。
「叭—叭—叭—」警鈴聲再次大聲地響起。
鐵門被撞開。
槍聲響起。
蹲在地上的妖精倒地不起。
另一名妖精跪在地上，用妖精語朝著闖入的獄卒求饒，換來的卻是一發子彈，打入他的腦袋。
聽見妖精語，巴巴發現事情似乎不太對勁，便和身邊的夥伴們討論接下來該怎麼做。洛根似乎躍躍欲試，劃開了自己的前臂，將流出的鮮血化為一把鮮紅色的劍，便朝著槍聲的來源衝去。其他三人則決定慢慢靠過去。
見到兩名突然死去的妖精，紅龍試著放火，阿基拉則朝著旁邊逃跑。
槍聲不斷響起，四名重裝的獄卒不斷開槍，獄友們努力抗戰，在生與死之間掙扎。終於，四名獄卒中有三名倒地不起，另一名則暫時消失在獄友們的視線範圍內。
眼看大好機會，巴巴趕緊從獄卒進來的門跑了出去，誰知道在他踏出門的那一刻，倒在地上的獄卒身體突然爆炸，站在獄卒旁的獄友們全數重傷，甚至死亡，而門外，盡是一片漆黑。跟隨著巴巴，紅龍和魔法香蕉先生兩人也成功地逃到了門外，一次次地踏出，一次次的爆炸，那些機械般的獄卒像是沒有血肉般的爆炸機器，除了流出黑色的油以外，毫無動靜。
走在漆黑的空間內，魔法香蕉先生摸著牆壁前行，紅龍與巴巴跟隨其後，最終找到了一口奇異的井：除了貼在地面上的井口外，還有個貼在他們頭頂上方，長得一模一樣的井，而洶湧的井水從上方的井口朝著下方沖。魔法香蕉先生試著爬上上方的井口，並釘上岩釘，卻在將岩釘牢牢釘上，並掛上他的繩子後，因為沒有抓穩，而落入井底的深淵。
看著魔法香蕉先生釘上的岩釘，巴巴抓著魔法香蕉先生掛上的繩索—此刻，他發現在急流的井水中竟然還有一根更為牢固的繩索，於是巴巴和紅龍便攀著繩索，努力的朝上爬。
爬了好一陣子後，似乎到了一層地面。兩人爬出了地面的井口，朝著旁邊的通道向前走。好一段時間後，他們開始聽見人聲，也看見了一扇木門。打開木門，似乎是一間小倉庫。巴巴和紅龍找到了倉庫通往外面的門，他們置身於巷弄之中。
問題是，此刻兩人依然穿著著獄衣。
兩人決定先躲回倉庫內，隨著兩名僕人出現在倉庫內，巴巴將兩人擊倒，換上了僕人裝，兩人小心翼翼的走了出去。
跟隨著大多數僕人的方向，兩人走到了一處柵門。衛兵似乎看見了紅龍身上有種不對勁的感覺，攔住了他，巴巴則順利的穿越了柵門外的王宮花園，邁向了自由。
被帶到一旁的紅龍機警的召喚出了兩隻冒火的生物，著實讓衛兵嚇得一身冷汗，便也決定放他離開。
最終，紅龍也走過了麥克嵩的王宮花園，遠離了他被關了好久好久的監獄。

For this side story, each character’s race and class was selected at random from a fixed list. Their six ability scores were 3, 3, 3, 18, 18, and 18, assigned in random order. Every character was level 3, and all other details followed the Player’s Handbook.
Would the loosened bars lead us to freedom—or cast us into the abyss?
It was 13891, 429 years after the founding of the New Dranison Dynasty, and humanity still harbored a deep hatred of nonhuman beings.
“Bwaa—bwaa—bwaa—” A deafening alarm rang through the cells, interrupting the prisoners’ already troubled sleep.
The dragonborn Red Dragon and the tiefling Akira, who shared a cell, got up to look around. Nothing moved in the corridor, but their barred door seemed loose. One hard pull made it slide open.
In another cell, the elf Baba and the gnome CHAD also woke to the alarm, pried open their unexpectedly loose bars, and stepped out.

The half-orc Magical Banana-san, whose cellmate had been released on bail the previous day, heard the alarm and hid in a dark corner. He glanced about nervously, but when nothing happened, he shouted in the Ninja language he knew well.

The bizarre Ninja language—a mixture of Common and tongues they had never heard—echoed between the cells. Baba and CHAD followed the sound. Hearing movement several cells away, they peered inside and found a man with a brightly painted face pressed close to the bars. He spoke to them with extreme nervousness. With their help, the man, Logan, escaped and joined them on the way toward the Ninja speech.

Red Dragon and Akira chose the opposite direction. After passing several cells, they saw two silent prisoners seated on the floor. Red Dragon tried to speak to them, but they answered in a language he did not understand. After much gesturing, threatening, and coaxing, the pair finally rose and approached. They appeared to be elves. Once the bars were pried open, all four continued away from the Ninja speech.

Magical Banana-san opened his bars and pressed cautiously against the wall, hiding at the corner. Baba, CHAD, and Logan then appeared from the opposite turn. Baba, who seemed to understand a little “Ninja,” tried speaking with the man shouting from the corner. Amazed by Baba’s fluency, Magical Banana-san ran out and cried, “Ninja Master!”

Red Dragon, Akira, and the two elves following them rounded another corner and found an iron door. One elf produced tools, crouched, and began working beneath it while his cellmate assisted. Red Dragon and Akira guarded opposite sides of the corner, fearing an ambush.
“Bwaa—bwaa—bwaa—” The alarm blared again.
The iron door burst open.
A gunshot rang out.
The crouching elf fell and did not rise.
The other elf dropped to his knees and begged the entering guards for mercy in Elvish. A bullet to the head was their answer.

Hearing Elvish, Baba realized something was wrong and discussed their next move with his companions. Logan seemed eager. He sliced open his forearm, shaped the flowing blood into a crimson sword, and charged toward the gunfire. The other three approached more cautiously.
Seeing the two elves die without warning, Red Dragon tried to breathe fire while Akira fled to the side.
Gunfire continued as four heavily armored guards fired relentlessly. The prisoners fought for their lives. At last, three guards lay motionless while the fourth temporarily vanished from sight.

Seizing the opportunity, Baba ran through the door the guards had used. The moment he crossed the threshold, a fallen guard exploded, gravely injuring or killing every prisoner nearby. Beyond the door lay total darkness. Red Dragon and Magical Banana-san followed Baba outside. Each departure brought another explosion: the mechanical guards burst like machines without flesh, leaking only black oil before falling still.

In the darkness, Magical Banana-san felt his way along the wall with Red Dragon and Baba behind him. They eventually found a strange well. One opening lay in the floor; an identical opening hung directly above them, pouring a torrent of water downward. Magical Banana-san tried climbing to the upper opening and hammered in a piton. After fastening his rope, he lost his grip and fell into the abyss below.
Looking at Magical Banana-san’s piton, Baba took hold of the rope he had left behind. Then he noticed a sturdier rope within the rushing water. Baba and Red Dragon grabbed it and struggled upward.

After a long climb, they seemed to reach another floor. They emerged from its well and followed a passage until they heard voices and saw a wooden door. It opened into a small storeroom. Finding another door outside, Baba and Red Dragon stepped into an alley.
The problem was that both were still wearing prison uniforms.
They hid in the storeroom. When two servants entered, Baba knocked them out, and the escapees changed into their clothes before cautiously venturing outside.
Following the flow of servants, they reached a gate. A guard sensed something amiss about Red Dragon and stopped him, but Baba crossed the palace garden beyond the gate and walked toward freedom.
Taken aside, Red Dragon cleverly summoned two flaming creatures. The guards broke into a cold sweat and decided to let him leave.
At last, Red Dragon too crossed the royal garden of Macksohn and left far behind the prison that had held him for so very long.
